title: Won't work on most CARPET!!
text: Won't work on most CARPET!!. IMPOSSIBLE on most carpet!  Buy only if you want to use it on hardwood or tile!  I just got this vacuum and the suction is so strong that you literally cannot push it forward on carpet.  I have just a medium to med-low pile, not shag or anything, and the vacuum is almost glued to the floor.  There are no pile adjustments, and I did try both the MAX setting and with that off.  From other reviews, people have called Dyson and been told "we could not test our vacuum on all kinds of carpet."  What a load of bull that is!  GREAT suction and great if you have hard surfaces, but if you want a vacuum for CARPET - look elsewhere!!

description: The Dyson Small Ball upright has the most powerful suction of any lightweight vacuum¹. It weighs just 12.15 lbs., so it’s easier to carry around the home and lift up stairs. With a retractable handle, it takes up to 50% less storage space than a full-size upright vacuum. The self-adjusting cleaner head automatically seals in suction across carpets and hard floors. It’s also has carbon fiber filaments on the brush bar, so it captures fine dust from hard floors while the direct drive motor pushes bristles deeper into carpets for a more thorough clean. Dyson’s patented Ball technology means it’s easy to maneuver around furniture and obstacles. It includes a 5 year warranty covering parts and labor.
